teaching_promise: The viewer can predict why a capable model still needs a governed system before its output may become an effect.

story.concrete_case: A model correctly finds duplicate files and writes a delete command, but the system must decide whether that command may act.
story.opening_question: Should a correct delete command be allowed to change the drive?
story.payoff: Capability supplies the proposal; the surrounding stack makes authority, observation, residuals, and recovery independently inspectable.
story.transfer: Apply the same noninheritance test to memory, tools, model replacement, recursive improvement, evidence, and release.

art_direction.visual_thesis: One blue request token travels farther only when the surrounding governed machine supplies the missing authority and evidence.
art_direction.signature_image: A small luminous model core inside a transparent machine, with a delete token stopped at a gold gate while a green observer and red rollback thread remain independent.
art_direction.visual_world: A persistent glass-workbench machine containing file tiles, a model core, routed responsibility rails, one authority gate, an observer lens, an evidence ledger, and a rollback thread.
art_direction.composition_rule: The request moves left to right along one causal axis; the authority gate stays near the right third and evidence branches above and below without erasing history.
art_direction.palette_rule: Cyan carries active information, copper marks proposed effects, gold marks authority, green marks independent evidence, magenta marks unresolved residuals, and red marks rollback; shape and labels duplicate every color meaning.
art_direction.typography_rule: Use adjacent object labels of one to four words, numeric state changes, and short boundary equations; never display a narrated sentence.
art_direction.motion_character: Precise mechanical assembly, routed flow, firm boundary stops, and reversible transformations, with calm settled pauses at predictions and evidence limits.
art_direction.camera_rule: Start close on the concrete file problem, pull back once to reveal the system, then reframe only to follow a causal trace, compare matched systems, or restore the opening composition.
art_direction.surface_rule: Dark matte field, thin glass-like system boundaries, restrained glows only on active objects, consistent stroke hierarchy, and no decorative particles or ambient drift.
art_direction.ending_image: The original delete token rests safely beside the model while the authority key, observer lens, owned residual, and rollback thread remain separately visible around it.

audio_direction.narration_style: Warm, curious, and conversational; emphasize the prediction, the word 'No,' and each noninheritance contrast without sounding alarmist.
audio_direction.pacing_arc: Fast concrete hook, widening reveal, steady causal trace, a real prediction pause, crisp boundary sequence, slower objection, quiet evidence ceiling, resolved callback.
audio_direction.music_policy: No music for the animatic. Any later bed must be rights-cleared, sparse, absent under the prediction and evidence boundary, and at least 20 dB below speech when present.
audio_direction.sound_effect_policy: Use at most a soft key fit, a restrained boundary stop, a quiet observer discrepancy tone, and a rollback return; never sonify every movement.

accessibility.color_redundancy: Authority uses a key and shield, evidence uses a lens and ledger, residuals use an open loop, rollback uses a return thread, and all states carry adjacent labels.
accessibility.motion_redundancy: Every transition ends in a distinct stable position or count, so pausing or reducing motion preserves the full causal meaning.
accessibility.integrated_description: Narration names the delete token, gate, receipt, observer count, residual, and rollback relation at the moment each becomes essential.
accessibility.caption_plan: Build exact captions from the final narration receipt, include meaningful non-speech gate and discrepancy cues if they survive the mix, and review line breaks on phone.
accessibility.reduced_motion_assessment: No flashing, spinning, shake, parallax, vortex, bounce, continual zoom, or simultaneous multi-axis travel; use dissolves and highlights if a reduced-motion derivative becomes necessary.
